units.rationale: Every named referent resolves. ViewingStatePolicy.minimumContentDurationSeconds is 15*60=900 (Modules/Playback/Domain/ViewingState.swift:51) and generated-viewing-storage-h264-16m01s-v1 declares durationSeconds 961.0, so the retention claim is exact. resumePromptPresentations/automaticResumeBypasses/pendingResumePrompt are published by PlayerUI-playback-state (Apps/Enchron/MainView.swift:1078-1080) and increment only on the seconds>0 arms at PlaybackLaunchCoordinator.swift:178 and :195, exactly as criterion 2 states. Producer call 26 is diagnostics.playback-state@1, whose handler echoes relatedResults (regression_operation_adapter.py:6982-6983), so relatedResults[0] carrying call 24's pre-Play-Next session is inside the one bound artifact. HC-013 is status decided in Regression/semantic-authority.json with the bypass implemented, so it blocks nothing.

The evidence closes inside one artifact: producer call 05 is playback.await-window-state@1, whose handler takes the PlayerUI-playback-state probe immediately after the wait and returns both readings (regression_operation_adapter.py HEAD lines 6939-6944, shifted only by uncommitted working-tree edits on this branch). Every field the criteria name exists on the window control plane - presentation MainView.swift:716, attached :732, videoVisible :749, lifecycle :782, position :797 - and missingIdentityFields is computed at adapter:6982. The 0-through-5-second bound is the HC-021 observed-position rule, which is status decided and names 5 seconds after exact target binding.

VISUAL_FROZEN_SSIM is exactly 0.995 at Scripts/verification/playback_mode_matrix.py:1329, so the frozen-frame threshold is named against source rather than invented. Producer call 07 is evidence.capture-frames@1 with count 3 and minimumIntervalMillis 1000, and each frame carries its own playbackState.fields plus screenshotDigest (adapter:3934-3950), so fixture identity travels with every frame and the time separation the SSIM pair needs is guaranteed by the interval argument. The 1x1-is-Indeterminate control matches the capture-validity rule in .agents/skills/vp-e2e/SKILL.md, and provenance-free capture is routed to Indeterminate rather than Violated as oracle-protocol.md requires.

Producer call 06 is diagnostics.playback-state@1 with empty arguments, and that one probe holds every field the single criterion needs: mediaName and session identity with missingIdentityFields (adapter:6968-6982), lifecycle (MainView.swift:1071), position (:1086) and pendingResumePrompt for the no-resume-decision clause (:1080). The named file sdr-bframe-multiaudio-avsync-30s.mp4 is what call 03 imports and call 04 opens, so the criterion binds the real fixture rather than a phantom. The 0-to-5-second window is the HC-021 observed-position bound around an exact target of zero, and HC-021 is decided.

Each criterion is scoped to the bound caseKey, so no criterion quantifies across the three cases; the cross-case conjunction stays in the Scenario success.all. The sourceKind mapping matches _external_subtitle_source_kind (adapter:7320-7333): local-sidecar, source-directory-sidecar and emby-external-stream are the only closed values it returns. fixture-registry.json:472 is the zh-CN.srt sidecar and :482 the styled.ass beside it, and the trackLabel is what disambiguates the tapFirstMatch --identifier-prefix PlayerUI-menu-subtitles-external.subtitle. selection (adapter:7379-7393); the Emby case needs no label because regression_emby_source.py:33 names one external file. discoveredTracks, selectedTrack, settlement and identityObservation are all real return fields (adapter:7546-7573) and settlement.observations carries each polled identity so preservation is checkable beside the flags rather than only asserted.

Producer call 02 is library.snapshot@1, whose handler parses the listLibrary payload into entries with kind reference and name (adapter:6586-6591), so counting exactly one reference named sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv is a structural read of the one bound artifact. That basename is exactly what call 01 imports, and the fixture generated-sdr-avc-bframe-aggregate-30s-v1 is registered with that deviceImportPath, so the criterion names something that exists. The negative controls separate a missing reference, a duplicate and a wrong name, which are the three ways the ingest state can be wrong.

Producer call 05 is accessibility.inspect@2, which returns the whole snapshot response including the main-window hierarchy text (adapter:4355-4362), so exactly one card is countable rather than inferred from a single matchedElement. The imported file name is fixed by call 01's argument and by the inspect's own requestedIdentifier MediaLibrary-grid-video-sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv, which the handler echoes, so the Oracle does not have to invent the referent. The stale-tree control is real because call 03 relaunches between the import and the inspect.

The four criteria are each guarded by one caseKey, so each obligation's single artifact carries what its own criterion needs and no criterion reaches across cases. ffmpeg.subtitle.N is the FFmpeg stream index (PlaybackCore/MediaSourceInformation.swift:409), and sdr-bframe-multiaudio-subtitles-30s.mkv holds one video plus two AAC tracks, putting subrip at 3 and dvb_subtitle at 5, which matches the registered cue text Enchron 字幕验证 and the bitmapCue titled Enchron generated bitmap proof with top-safe-area color bars. The off criterion is decidable from each frame's own playbackState.fields, and the two cited lines are exact: WindowPlayerDeck.swift:324 is the Off row whose isSelected is current==nil, and MainView.swift:1141 prints off for that same nil.

Every field the criteria read is on the bound capture-frames artifact: playbackState and controlPlane per frame with controlPlane actually populated because the context is window rather than panorama or docked (adapter:3921-3931), loadingSpinner at MainView.swift:780, error at :1148 and demuxForwardBytes at :1137. The remoteObservation binding is per case and real: the healthy branch reads remoteGenerationToken and sets restoredGeneration to that generation (adapter:4585-4606), while buffer-absorbed-interruption refuses the second ranged primary read with 503 and Retry-After 0 (regression_remote_source.py:788-798) so triggeredRequests is nonempty and recoveredRequests is the later 206 for the same range (adapter:4751-4759). The mixed-modality clause routes a missing modality to Indeterminate as oracle-protocol.md requires.

deliveredCloseEvents, playbackPromptEvents, afterClose, storedFingerprintAfterClose and currentFingerprintTrustedAfterClose are all real fields of certificate_change_observation (adapter:1136-1143), and the post-Close trust mapping is the certificateTrustProbe payload whose schema enchron.regression.certificate-trust-probe@1 the adapter validates at :6917. The third negative control gets the witness right: it states explicitly that the host remoteObservation fingerprints are server certificates and cannot establish storedFingerprintAfterClose, which is the app-side fact, so the rubric asks each source only for what it holds. Producer call 12 is the post-Close surface probe with call 10's pre-Close fields inlined as relatedResults[0], so both sides of the transition sit in one artifact.

PB_DEMUX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPT_LIMIT is sizeof over PB_DEMUX_RECONNECT_BACKOFF_MILLISECONDS {250,500,1000} at PlaybackFFmpegBridge.c:107-110, so the limit is 3 and the declared table is exactly what the criterion lists; the host mirrors it as RECONNECT_BACKOFF_MILLIS at regression_remote_source.py:62. reconnectAttempts entries carry ordinal, declaredBackoffMillis, observedDelayMillis and recovered (adapter:4816-4824), and the adapter comment at :4793-4797 defines observedDelayMillis as the gap from the refused read to the client's next request, which is the reading the criterion uses. The rubric refuses to invent an upper tolerance and says so against HC-021's outstanding version-reconnect-sampling item, leaving only the exact limit, the declared table and lower-bound plus ordering comparisons - all decidable from the one bound artifact.

The four recipe-to-category pairs are the real enum values connection-interrupted, source-file-missing, source-access-denied and media-data-corrupt (Modules/Playback/Domain/PlaybackUserVisibleIssue.swift:10-13), and the issue snapshot criterion 2 names is the inlined call-10 fields, which is the only reading in the artifact that can hold a non-none category. The action inventory is decidable because the issue inspect ran with requireMatchedElement on PlayerUI-loadFailure-primary and its full hierarchy response is inlined beside its matchedElement, and all three identifiers exist at MainView.swift:1315, :1325 and :1337 so the absence of PlayerUI-playbackIssue-confirm is a real assertion. The rubric explicitly refuses to read the post-tap interaction as evidence of either action's presence, and both the activation and restoration receipts travel as relatedResults (adapter:4901 and :4939-4941).
